description: Unofficial Substack Notes endpoints observed from the authenticated web app.

novel_features.name: Guided browser-session auth
novel_features.description: Discovers a local signed-in Substack browser session and stores the cookie header without printing secret values.

novel_features.name: Recent Notes reader
novel_features.description: Reads and normalizes recent published Notes from the authenticated profile or an explicit user id.

novel_features.name: Image-backed Notes workflow
novel_features.description: Uploads an image, creates an attachment, and publishes or drafts the Note only after media preparation succeeds.
